label: Bible Study
prompt: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was _____ and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.
verse: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.
note: The opening of Job — the land of Uz, a good man, and no hint yet of the storm coming.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into _____: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
verse: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
note: Mourning swapped for dancing, sackcloth for gladness — God runs a generous wardrobe exchange.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he had an _____ of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.
verse: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.
note: Goliath's gear: a brass helmet and a coat of mail weighing five thousand shekels — he dressed for a much longer fight.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again _____: why then call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?
verse: I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again empty: why then call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?
note: Naomi left Bethlehem with a family and came home with none — except a daughter-in-law who wouldn't leave.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to _____ all the fiery darts of the wicked.
verse: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
note: The shield of faith can 'quench all the fiery darts of the wicked' — flaming arrows put out on impact.
